name: Kawagoe Kurazukuri District
description: Kawagoe's 'Little Edo' Kurazukuri warehouse district — black clay-walled merchant storehouses along the Ichibangai shopping street with the Toki no Kane bell tower — is a designated Important Preservation District for Groups of Traditional Buildings (重伝建).
notes: Kawagoe's Kurazukuri district is an open preserved street — freely walkable any time. The Toki no Kane bell tower and Ichibangai shops line the route.
notesJa: 【見どころ】蔵造りの商家が並ぶ一番街は常時散策可能。時の鐘や老舗の店々が軒を連ねます。
parking: Paid public parking in the city center (fee varies)
parkingJa: 【駐車場】市街地の有料駐車場を利用（場所により異なる）
openingHoursJa: 通りは常時開放（施設により異なる）
